subject: reasoning
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are given below. Which is the number on the face opposite to the face containing 2?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d4a6e4898e22aac4d00cd637c21ab94c358bbfad1e3f8022646b9e202e8673e2.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given two different cubes the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As 6 is common on both the dices, it is clear that 5, 4, 1, and 3 are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. 2 will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c49f94ad8bf3fb6a1a99f7c382da3559f19cc8c51b1f2aec28dba5d06f392da.png] 

Opposite pairs:

4 → 3

5 → 1

6 → 2

So, the opposite side of "2" will be side "6".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
